thread:
rachel: FYI PR #904 adds a condensed troubleshooting recipe for 429s/timeouts/context-eviction. Quick sweep needed for SDK sample parity and a short 'what to check' checklist.
omar: Point me at the lines. I can update snippets and add a tiny migration note.
li: The first JS snippet still shows `opts.max_inflight` and `retryOn429: true`. In SDK 0.9+ the property is `concurrency_limit` and retries are managed by runtime fallbacks.
brooke: Also the Python example references `context_budget=4096` but we now expose `window_tokens` and recommend users prefer prefix caching first.
li: Proposed diff:```diff
- client.init(opts={max_inflight: 20, retryOn429: True})
+ client.init(opts={concurrency_limit: 20})
```
omar: I'll patch the Python snippet too and add a one-line migration row in the doc's top callout: old name -> new name -> quick action.
brooke: Can we add an explicit short troubleshooting checklist titled "If 429s increase after upgrade" with three fast actions: 1) temporarily lower concurrency_limit, 2) enable prefix/KV cache, 3) add exponential backoff with jitter client-side. Keep it actionable for support.
rachel: Yes. Also include a minimal staging repro command so Support/QA can generate similar load: `hey -n 800 -c 60 https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate` and mention to run from same region.
li: Suggest also adding a single sentence about batching tradeoffs: increasing batch_window reduces per-token CPU but may raise p99 under bursty tails.
brooke: I'll add a tiny example under examples/that runs the snippet against a local mock and wire it to docs CI. Fails the PR if API drifts.
doc-bot: docs-qa checklist attached to PR #904: samples-lint, migration-callout, examples-run, links-verified
omar: Timeline: I'll land the snippet fixes + migration row today. Brooke will add the example and CI hook by EOD tomorrow.
rachel: After merge, create a backport issue for the older troubleshooting page so users on older SDKs see the migration note.
doc-bot: backport issue queued post-merge. :white_check_mark:
